resources.string: Everywhere — YouTube, Instagram, Google, Gallery — blurs images of non-mahram people.
Once: on the page that opens, find “Muslim Shield” and turn it on (Accessibility → Installed services → Muslim Shield → On).
If it won\'t turn on and says “Restricted setting”: tap the button below → ⋮ (top) → “Allow restricted settings”, then try again.
Everything runs on the phone; no internet is needed and nothing is sent. The app tells men and women apart by the face and can sometimes be wrong.
Muslim Shield checks the screen image only on the phone and blurs photos and videos of non-mahram people. No image is stored or sent.
Fast mode is better for scrolling and video. After each restart, tap “Start now” once.

Muslim Shield was made to protect a Muslim\'s eyes from looking at non-mahram people.\n\nThe app finds faces in photos and videos on the phone — YouTube, Instagram, Google, Gallery and any other app — and blurs non-mahram people: women for men, and men for women.
Everything happens only on the phone. No image is stored or sent to the internet.
The man/woman recognition model was trained by «БИХОН» on the FairFace dataset (Kärkkäinen & Joo, CC BY 4.0).
